info.title: BMS Monitor API
info.description: Read-only LAN telemetry. UTC reception time is not measurement time. Additive response fields are permitted; known fields remain strictly validated.

get.description: No query parameters. Latest measurement includes invalid records; it never silently falls back to last_valid. Stale when age > 20 seconds. No cache.

200.description: Latest measurement, including stale or invalid.

post.summary: Persist one source record; no collector implementation
post.description: Maximum 65536 bytes, JSON depth32. Source received_at is immutable, <=6 fractional digits and not future. Same identity and content returns200, conflict409. Only acknowledged after commit. Record object retained as semantic JSON.

get.summary: Discover original record identities and metadata
get.description: Fixed configured device only. Half-open [from,to), positive interval at most six hours. Includes boot,event,measurement rows, ordered by received_at,boot_id,sequence. Metadata and revision are read in one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY snapshot. At most5000 rows, overflow422 range_too_dense without partial data. Source record JSON is not loaded.

schema.description: RFC3339 with at most six fractional second digits.
RFC3339 with at most six fractional second digits.

422.description: Invalid parameters, range_too_dense, or record_too_large; no partial/truncated response.

503.description: Database unavailable or malformed stored metadata.

get.summary: Coherent snapshot for stream bootstrap or recovery
Bounded raw history with explicit missing-data intervals
get.description: UTC half-open interval, maximum6 hours, 5000 in-range measurements. Excess density422. Boundary neighbours support gap calculation, not returned as points. Coverage is observation coverage, not power availability or energy.

get.summary: Bounded history presets with prepared summaries and explicit pending intervals
get.description: One server-time snapshot for both metrics. 10m/1h use bounded raw data; longer ranges use prepared 5-minute/hour/day summaries, with at most two bounded partial five-minute raw edges. 3mo/1y subtract calendar months in Europe/Kyiv with end-of-month clamping. Pending preparation is not a measurement gap. Mean is sample-weighted; min/max preserve peaks. History preparation events use history.updated.v1 on the existing Mercure topic and an independent aggregate_revision. Optional set=overview|cells adds typed additional metrics: per-interval detail_status and compact summaries for aggregate ranges, and per-point values for raw ranges. Without set the response is unchanged.

409.description: Active request; error.active_request is its UUID

200.description: Token stays bound even after terminal state

413.description: Request body exceeds the size limit
Request body exceeds the size limit

200.description: Decoded by default. raw returns the entire original semantic JSON envelope without presentation rounding.

get.summary: Detailed original measurement history with explicit gaps
get.description: Half-open [from,to), positive interval at most six hours, at most5000 measurement rows. Reads revision, measurements and two coverage neighbours in one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY snapshot. Neighbours affect coverage only and are not returned. Overflow422 range_too_dense; no truncation. Uses the existing gap rules; charts and aggregation are unchanged. Optional frame fragments are type/size checked by SQL before PHP transfer.

503.description: Stored data cannot be interpreted safely or database unavailable.

get.summary: Read one original source record or its bounded decoded projection
get.description: Fixed configured device, exact boot_id+sequence primary key. Default view=raw returns metadata+complete semantic record, preserving unknown properties and numeric digits. PostgreSQL checks the full JSON response is at most1048576 bytes before transferring it to PHP; oversize422 record_too_large, never truncation. view=decoded loads only bounded, type-checked fragments, never entire record/source_record JSON. Read-only AA counters support22/24-byte payloads. Malformed optional capture remains explicit unavailable and does not destroy valid base telemetry.

404.description: No row with this identity for the configured device.

422.description: Invalid parameters, range_too_dense, or record_too_large; no partial/truncated response.

503.description: Database unavailable or malformed required stored data.

get.summary: Registered energy per Europe/Kyiv calendar day
get.description: Every day of the range, oldest first. Energy and coverage come only from prepared summaries with detail, using the coverage support rule; nothing is credited across gaps. Small currents reported as zero are not registered.
Protection bit set/clear and charge/discharge switch transitions between adjacent valid measurements. Pauses and restarts are not events. Interpretation of protection signals is unconfirmed.

current_a.description: Signed battery current in amperes: positive means charging, negative means discharging, exactly zero means no charging or discharging. Null means unavailable.

current_capacity_unit.description: Reported current/capacity decoding scale; absent or malformed source extension is null.

firmware_raw.description: Raw BMS software-version byte, not ESP32 firmware.

Battery.description: Physical numeric output uses at most three fractional decimals. Nonzero values that would round to zero retain their value. Raw stored records and domain calculations are never rounded.

mode.description: For fresh valid measurements: charge when current_a > 0, discharge when current_a < 0, idle only when current_a = 0, unknown when current_a is unavailable. No deadband. The installation owner defines idle as mains / no charging; there is no independent mains-presence signal.

current_a.description: Signed battery current in amperes: positive means charging, negative means discharging, exactly zero means no charging or discharging. Null means unavailable.
Signed battery current in amperes: positive means charging, negative means discharging, exactly zero means no charging or discharging. Null means unavailable.

voltage_v.description: Present only in history series with set=overview.

temperatures_c.description: Present only in history series with set=overview.

cells_v.description: Present only in history series with set=cells.

cell_delta_mv.description: Present only in history series with set=cells.

detail_status.description: Present only with set=overview|cells. pending means the additional values are still being prepared; it is never an empty interval. A pending interval status implies pending detail.

detail.description: Present only with set=overview|cells; null while detail_status is pending.

soc_percent.description: set=overview; null when pending or without values.

voltage_v.description: set=overview; null when pending or without values.

temperatures_c.description: set=overview; one entry per sensor index up to the highest present index, null for an index without values. Null when pending.

cells_v.description: set=cells; one entry per cell index up to the highest present index, null for an index without values. Null when pending.

cell_delta_mv.description: set=cells; null when pending or without values.

detail_processing_status.description: Present only with set=overview|cells: ready when every interval has detail.

detail_prepared_coverage_seconds.description: Present only with set=overview|cells: total duration of intervals whose detail is ready.

DetailedMeasurement.description: One original measurement with bounded optional protocol decoding. Original numeric precision is retained in storage. Physical numeric presentation follows Battery; invalid/missing optional frames do not replace a valid battery with zero.

DecodedRecord.description: measurement is populated for measurement rows only, including invalid rows. jbd contains a separately supplied record.jbd_capture (for example AA counters), if present. Dynamic 03/04 decoding belongs to measurement.jbd. Unknown record additions are available only through view=raw.

RawRecord.description: metadata describes the database observation. record is the complete original semantic source JSON, including unknown additions and original numeric digits. Returned directly from PostgreSQL JSON text without PHP decoding or presentation rounding. Original whitespace and property order are not retained.

active_request.description: Existing active configuration request when error.code is active_request.

HistorySet.description: basic keeps the original response. overview adds soc_percent, voltage_v and temperatures_c; cells adds cells_v and cell_delta_mv.

HistoryCompactSummary.description: Sample-weighted summary of one additional metric inside one interval. Continuity is shared, see HistoryDetailContinuity.

HistoryDetailContinuity.description: Valid-measurement continuity shared by all additional metrics of one interval.

observed_coverage_seconds.description: Coverage of prepared intervals with detail only.

charged_wh.description: Registered charging energy, Wh; null when observed coverage is zero.

discharged_wh.description: Registered discharging energy, Wh; null when observed coverage is zero.

status.description: outside: the whole day precedes prepared history. ready: the whole day is prepared, unmarked and has detail. Otherwise partial; the current day is always partial.

prepared_from.description: Lower bound of verified prepared history; null before preparation starts.

occurred_at.description: received_at of the second of two adjacent valid measurements.

bit.description: Protection bit; null for charge/discharge switch events.

label.description: Ukrainian signal name; bits 16-30 are named as unknown.

severity.description: important only for setting protection bits 0-11, 13, 14.

after_gap.description: More than 10 seconds between the two measurements; the moment inside the gap is unknown.

latest_important_at.description: Start of the latest important episode (no set of the same bit during the preceding 30 minutes) if it is not older than 7 days; otherwise null.

next_before.description: Opaque cursor for the next older page.
